load_checkpoint: load a checkpoint from a file path using dill and return the deserialized data or None if not found
review_load_checkpoint: review the load_checkpoint function that reads serialized checkpoint data from a file using dill
test_load_checkpoint: test the load_checkpoint function by loading a checkpoint file and verifying the returned data
refactor_load_checkpoint: refactor the load_checkpoint function to support additional serialization formats beyond dill
summarize_load_checkpoint: summarize the load_checkpoint function which deserializes checkpoint data from a binary file
